races.paceDynamic: Salsinha will dictate from the front with Aruntothequeen and Turn Up The Heat for company in the early stages, but the pace will be sustainable rather than punishing in this large maiden field. The majority of runners are hold-up types including Switch From Diesel, Cool As A Cat, and Claudel, creating a packed finish. With so many closers and limited early pace pressure, the race will develop into a sprint finish where positioning and timing become critical. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Salsinha and Aruntothequeen can dictate reasonable fractions without pressure...
scenarios.body: The early leaders maintain their advantage as the large pack of hold-up horses gets bogged down in traffic behind them. Horses racing in the first four positions turning for home have a decisive tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where the best horse wins regardless of position, allowing talented hold-up types to overcome the tactical disadvantage. Switch From Diesel's class and Full Of Shade's Mullins polish could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Longshot Traffic Beneficiary
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get caught in a pocket or check...
scenarios.body: A horse drawn well or ridden aggressively gains a crucial position advantage while better fancied rivals are shuffled back. The tactical benefit outweighs class differences in a competitive maiden.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Salsinha kicks clear approaching the last hurdle...
scenarios.body: The honest pace-setter finds another gear when asked, opening up a decisive advantage that the hold-up horses cannot peg back. Her proven stamina at the trip becomes the winning factor.

races.paceDynamic: Fedneys Park will take this field along from the front with Single Edition and Laurie Blue tracking prominently, creating a measured but honest gallop over this 2-mile trip. The large field of 22 runners features predominantly hold-up horses who will look to time their runs from off the pace, but with limited early pace this could become tactical. The lack of natural speed in behind means Fedneys Park can dictate terms without pressure, likely leading to a sprint finish where positioning will be crucial. This race shape favours prominent racers and those with proven finishing kicks from midfield rather than pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical sprint finish
scenarios.trigger: If Fedneys Park sets a steady pace and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with positioning crucial and those handy to the pace holding every advantage. Hold-up horses at the back struggle to make ground through the large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop favours stamina
scenarios.trigger: If Single Edition and Laurie Blue press Fedneys Park into a stronger tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace finds out the weak finishers and sets up the race for horses with proven staying power and recent form. Those who can sustain their effort to the line prosper.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Fedneys Park gets an uncontested lead with the field settling too far back
scenarios.body: The De Bromhead-trained front-runner can control the race from pillar to post and prove hard to catch despite fading tendencies. The lack of early pressure plays into his hands perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners fail to apply any pressure and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with horses getting in each other's way and the finish line coming too soon for proper finishing efforts. Tactical speed from midfield becomes key.

watchPoints.text: Fedneys Park could steal this from the front if allowed an easy lead as the field lacks natural pace to pressure him
The large 22-runner field creates serious positioning problems for hold-up horses who need to be produced wide
Single Edition and Laurie Blue are the key pace protagonists who can track the leader and benefit from the tactical setup
Several runners including San Franco, Joshsue and Silent Flight are returning from long layoffs which makes them unreliable
The good going conditions have been consistent throughout the day at Punchestown which should suit the form horses

races.paceDynamic: Walk On Annilog leads with Lakefield Flyer, Walk Win, Only A Dollar, Baltinglass Hill and Urban War prominent early. The pace will be sustainable rather than fierce with limited early pressure on Walk On Annilog who can dictate terms. The large field of 22 runners creates positional challenges but the moderate early gallop allows prominent racers to secure good positions without stress. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with tactical speed who can navigate through the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Annilog sets steady fractions without being harassed early
scenarios.body: Lakefield Flyer and Urban War can sit in perfect striking positions behind the leader and kick clear when the pace lifts approaching the final flight. Their prominent style matches perfectly with this controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows strong finishers like Tippin And Tappin and Spanish Maid to get into contention from off the pace. They can use their finishing kick to great effect when the race develops into a sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Annilog faces no serious early challenges and gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: He can control every phase of the race and prove hard to peg back despite his moderate recent form. The lack of aggressive pace-pressers plays directly into his hands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Annilog goes too slowly and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The 22-runner field bunches dangerously and it becomes a lottery with any hold-up horse capable of emerging. Traffic problems and luck in running become decisive factors.

races.paceDynamic: Captains Speech and That's It Paddy will clash early as confirmed front runners, with both needing to lead. This creates an honest gallop over the extended 3-mile trip, particularly with Captains Speech showing recent form suggesting he'll want to dictate terms. The early pace battle will stretch the field, with prominent runners like Vienna Storm, Lemmy Caution and Nopresentliketime tracking behind. This contested early pace over the marathon trip clearly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Captains Speech and That's It Paddy engage in a pace duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop over 3 miles will drain the early leaders, setting up the race perfectly for closers. The Rebel Fox and Papagei can use their hold-up styles to maximum advantage in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal tracking position behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: Vienna Storm or Lemmy Caution can capitalise on their tactical positioning to strike when the leaders weaken. The Mullins-trained Vienna Storm particularly appeals with Townend knowing when to make his move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Captains Speech can shake off That's It Paddy early and control the tempo alone
scenarios.body: Without a sustained pace battle, Captains Speech can dictate a more manageable rhythm and use his proven stamina. His recent consistent form suggests he has the class to dominate from the front if left alone.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock maiden winner
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Quest For Answers or Union Boy possess hidden ability on Rules debut
scenarios.body: Either newcomer could spring a surprise if their pointing background translates effectively to hurdling. Their unknown quantities could catch the more exposed rivals off-guard in a competitive maiden.

races.paceDynamic: Schiehallion will set the tempo with It's Time Again, Ballagh Star, and Joe's Turn pressing close behind in the early stages. The pace will be genuine but sustainable over this 3-mile trip, with no tearaway leaders to create a collapse scenario. The majority of the field are hold-up performers including Cullig, Where Are You Now, Creadan Grace, and Wakey Wakey Man, creating a wall of finishers hitting the line together. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails Clean
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners avoid jumping errors and maintain their positions turning for home
scenarios.body: The early pace-setters will have first run on the field while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind the leaders. Schiehallion, It's Time Again, and Ballagh Star can dictate terms without being headed by the wall of closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Wall Swamps Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the second-last hurdle and gaps appear for the back-markers
scenarios.body: The prominent group will tie up slightly allowing the fresher hold-up horses to surge through with Wakey Wakey Man and Cullig having Jack Kennedy and superior class respectively. The strong pace will suit those who conserved energy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or significant interference occurs in the home straight involving the market leaders
scenarios.body: The disruption will eliminate several fancied runners and allow a horse like Smackwater Jack or Halsafari to benefit from a clear run when others are hampered. Foster and Barcoe's experience will prove crucial in the mayhem.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Exposes Weakness
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected and becomes truly searching over the final mile
scenarios.body: Several runners will empty out completely in the final furlong with only the most genuine stayers reaching the line strongly. Ballagh Star's recent Dunleavy form and It's Time Again's consistency will shine through when others fade.

races.paceDynamic: The Cheeky Pup is the only confirmed front runner in this 20-runner handicap hurdle, likely to dictate terms from the front with Oogum Boogum, Written In My Soul, Johnny M and Max Time settling prominently behind. With such a large field and minimal early pace pressure, The Cheeky Pup can establish a controlled gallop through the early stages before the pace inevitably quickens approaching the business end. However, with 15 hold-up horses including class acts like Journey So Far, Spellacy's Cross and Annie Button, this becomes a tactical waiting game where stamina and a strong finish will prove decisive over 3 miles. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained runs from off the pace in the final mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Cheeky Pup sets steady fractions and the pace quickens late
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade get the perfect scenario with plenty to aim at when unleashed in the straight. Strong stayers like Journey So Far, Spellacy's Cross and Annie Button can use their class advantage with sustained finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses maintain position as pace quickens approaching 2 out
scenarios.body: Oogum Boogum and Written In My Soul avoid the traffic problems that plague the hold-up horses in such a large field. Their forward position allows them to capitalize when the pace lifts genuinely for the first time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If The Cheeky Pup goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with no true gallop test, suiting the lighter weights with tactical speed. Queen Kulina and Rideau Canal benefit from their low weights in a bunched finish where class matters less.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If The Cheeky Pup gets loose on the lead and nothing can reel him in
scenarios.body: Despite his tendency to fade, The Cheeky Pup gets such an easy lead that he has enough left to repel late challengers. The prominent horses pick up the pieces behind but cannot bridge the gap created by his uncontested advantage.

watchPoints.text: The Cheeky Pup sets uncontested fractions early - if he gets loose on the lead, this could become a procession
Traffic problems in the straight with 15 hold-up horses all looking for room simultaneously in a 20-runner field
Journey So Far's fade tendency over this trip despite his class advantage and strong trainer record
Annie Button's recent winning form and Jack Kennedy booking suggests strong confidence from connections
Written In My Soul maintaining his prominent position throughout - any drift back suggests trouble
